decision.reason: The experimental renderer failed the declared CPU and presentation gates; Unicode CPU and tail latency regressed in the formal comparison.
retained: Benchmark-only independent GPU/presentation correlation with explicit serial-input and overflow contracts.
Two bursty scenes and separate profile mode.
270-frame Unicode equivalence matrix plus three geometry/composition fallback cases.
decision.stopping_policy: No second optimization line or GPU/cell/VT/polling rewrite follows in this pass.
decision.limits: Three short runs per version on one host, synthetic input, no confidence intervals, instrumented terminal-view modules. Do not claim process energy savings, a Unicode speedup, physical input latency, or Ghostty full-app parity.
